verdict.rationale: Letta ships a documented Agent SDK (TypeScript) with detailed docs on agent creation, sessions, streaming, permissions, MCP tool integration, browser/mobile support, and deployment options, corroborated by the official GitHub repo describing it as 'the Letta Agent SDK for building agents into TypeScript applications'. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond TypeScript (e.g., Python/other languages), and independent third-party developer reviews validating real-world SDK integration quality.
